description: This file defines the AwsException class, a specialized exception class for AWS SDK errors, including methods for retrieving error details, request/response info, and handling transfer stats.

classes.name: AwsException
classes.description: A custom exception class for AWS SDK errors, providing detailed error info, request/response access, and transfer stats management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with message, command, context, and previous exception.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including nested exception info.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command associated with the exception.

methods.name: getAwsErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the AWS error message if available.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the error.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response associated with the error.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result object if available.

methods.name: isConnectionError
methods.description: Indicates if the error was a connection error.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response, if available.

methods.name: getAwsRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID from AWS, if available.

methods.name: getAwsErrorType
methods.description: Returns the AWS error type.

methods.name: getAwsErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the AWS error code.

methods.name: getAwsErrorShape
methods.description: Returns the AWS error shape.

methods.name: getTransferInfo
methods.description: Retrieves transfer statistics or specific info by name.

methods.name: setTransferInfo
methods.description: Sets transfer information for the exception.

methods.name: isMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks if max retries have been exceeded.

methods.name: setMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Flags that max retries have been exceeded.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the exception's data array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the exception's data array.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the exception's data.
